#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    std::vector<int> counts(3, 0);
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> positions(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int t = (s[i] == 'K') ? 0 : (s[i] == 'V') ? 1 : 2;
        positions[t].push_back(i);
        counts[t]++;
    }

    // Initialize 4D DP array: 2 x (counts[0]+1) x (counts[1]+1) x (counts[2]+1)
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> dp(2,
        std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(counts[0]+1,
            std::vector<std::vector<int>>(counts[1]+1,
                std::vector<int>(counts[2]+1, INT_MAX/2))));

    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int a = 0; a <= counts[0]; ++a) {
        for (int b = 0; b <= counts[1]; ++b) {
            for (int c = 0; c <= counts[2]; ++c) {
                for (int lastFlag = 0; lastFlag < 2; ++lastFlag) {
                    int currentCost = dp[lastFlag][a][b][c];
                    if (currentCost >= INT_MAX/2) continue;

                    // Try to pick from 'K' (index 0)
                    if (a < counts[0] && lastFlag == 0) {
                        int swaps = 0;
                        int posA = positions[0][a];
                        for (int i = b; i < counts[1]; ++i)
                            if (positions[1][i] < posA) swaps++;
                        for (int i = c; i < counts[2]; ++i)
                            if (positions[2][i] < posA) swaps++;
                        int newA = a + 1;
                        int newB = b;
                        int newC = c;
                        int newCost = currentCost + swaps;
                        if (dp[0][newA][newB][newC] > newCost)
                            dp[0][newA][newB][newC] = newCost;
                    }

                    // Try to pick from 'V' (index 1)
                    if (b < counts[1]) {
                        int swaps = 0;
                        int posB = positions[1][b];
                        for (int i = a; i < counts[0]; ++i)
                            if (positions[0][i] < posB) swaps++;
                        for (int i = c; i < counts[2]; ++i)
                            if (positions[2][i] < posB) swaps++;
                        int newA = a;
                        int newB = b + 1;
                        int newC = c;
                        int newCost = currentCost + swaps;
                        if (dp[1][newA][newB][newC] > newCost)
                            dp[1][newA][newB][newC] = newCost;
                    }

                    // Try to pick from 'C' (index 2)
                    if (c < counts[2]) {
                        int swaps = 0;
                        int posC = positions[2][c];
                        for (int i = a; i < counts[0]; ++i)
                            if (positions[0][i] < posC) swaps++;
                        for (int i = b; i < counts[1]; ++i)
                            if (positions[1][i] < posC) swaps++;
                        int newA = a;
                        int newB = b;
                        int newC = c + 1;
                        int newCost = currentCost + swaps;
                        if (dp[0][newA][newB][newC] > newCost)
                            dp[0][newA][newB][newC] = newCost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int answer = std::min(dp[0][counts[0]][counts[1]][counts[2]],
                          dp[1][counts[0]][counts[1]][counts[2]]);
    std::cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
